randomization.selection_method: Before consulting project candidate or profile data, define five ordered option lists of length five from general knowledge. Decode the seed as successive base-5 mixed-radix digits: index_d = floor(seed / 5^d) mod 5 for setting, event, lighting, camera, and composition.

required_component_groups.prepack_observation_target: A dedicated cabinet-style electronic instrument visibly reads as powered and operational.
One vertical rod antenna and one distinct horizontal loop antenna are both fully visible.
The performer's two hands occupy visibly separate pitch and volume control fields.
Clear air gaps are visible between each controlling hand and its antenna.
The object reads as the dedicated two-antenna field instrument rather than the MIDI-controller confounder.

allowed: visible makeup placement and skin-surface finish
